name: Bite Sweet
status: Scripts only; awaiting real human recordings.
performance: Affectionate, conversational teasing for your partner. Smile gently, use your natural voice, and sound encouraging. No imitation, music, or sound effects.

PLAN_DAY.line: Babe, even your to-do list is playing hard to get.
One little task, sweetheart. Let me cheer you on.
One small plan, babe. Let us make today yours.
Empty list, love? Give me one thing to celebrate.

CREATED.line: Look at you making plans, cutie. I'm taking notes.
Added, babe. Now comes the adorable part: doing it.
Another little plan, love. I am cheering already.
Added, sweetheart. We make a pretty good team.

STARTED.line: There you go, babe. That's my favorite plot twist.
Look at you go, cutie. I'm cheering already.
Look at you go, love. Extremely attractive productivity.
You started, babe. I knew you had this.

COMPLETED.line: You did it, babe. Proud of you, obviously.
Task finished. Cute and capable? Show-off.
Done already, love? Leave some brilliance for tomorrow.
That is my favorite overachiever. Nicely done, sweetheart.

COMPLETED_LATE.line: Fashionably late, babe. Still proud you finished.
Late entrance, lovely finish. Very you, sweetheart.
You finished, babe. I saved your imaginary victory hug.
A little late, love. Still very proud of you.

OVERDUE.line: Babe, that deadline wasn't playing hard to get.
Sweetheart, your task is waiting for its big moment.
Babe, your deadline is doing the dramatic sigh now.
Your task misses you, love. I understand the feeling.

SNOOZE.line: Later again, babe? Your task is practicing its pout.
Sweetheart, that task has had enough beauty sleep.
Later, sweetheart? Your task is getting adorably clingy.
Rescheduled, love. Your future self expects a little effort.

SNOOZE_REPEAT.line: Babe, this task has more rain checks than our dates.
Another tomorrow? Sweetheart, even procrastination needs a day off.
Babe, this task has more comebacks than our jokes.
Again, sweetheart? That checkbox is developing trust issues.

ABANDON.line: Back already, cutie? Your little missions saved your seat.
Babe, browsing the list doesn't count as a date.
Back again, love? Your task saved the best seat.
Missed you, sweetheart. The list was terrible company.

IDLE.line: Babe, your little missions could use a little attention.
Sweetheart, one small win would look good on you.
Thinking looks cute, babe. One small step looks cuter.
Still there, love? Your task wants a little attention.

TINY.line: Babe, this takes less time than picking a selfie.
Tiny task, sweetheart. You're giving it main-character drama.
Tiny task, sweetheart. You can beat my dramatic sigh.
Five minutes, babe. Then you can resume being adorable.

NOTIFICATION_CLEARED.line: Babe, smooth swipe. One little task next?
Cute dodge, sweetheart. Your plans are still waiting.
Nice swipe, babe. The task still wants your number.
Message dismissed, sweetheart. Your little mission is still waiting.
